name: seven_arm_octopus_male
description: Male seven-arm octopus (Haliphron atlanticus): same jelly-ruby animal as seven_arm_octopus, smaller and slimmer, with the eighth arm coiled tight as a visible wound-up tube (wine red, pale sucker dots, ~1.5 turns) inside a closed, bulging translucent lilac sac under the right eye at (+100,-100). Seven arms hang free in the web. Anchor centre, ~600x560.
